subcategory_gloss: earth and environmental science: water-quality monitoring of streams and wastewater
domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by environmental water-quality laboratory practice for the five-day biochemical oxygen demand test: which dilution bottles are readable (depletion and residual dissolved oxygen), how seed controls give a per-mL seed correction, how a bottle's BOD follows from depletion, seed and sample fraction, when a sample is only a bound, and how blanks, the GGA check and duplicates qualify a batch. The deliverable is the lab's reported BOD results, an environmental measurement; software is only the vehicle. Chemistry would misplace it (no chemical analysis or calibration is judged; the judgement is the field/lab water-quality reduction), and Operations/Compliance would misplace it (no regulation or permit is applied; the SOP is a measurement procedure).
